difference_explaining_2p559_vs_5p643: the particle velocity-quadrature layout changed from randomized per-cell to globally shuffled; metric, Fourier scope, PPC, high-PPC reference, time window, and 51-snapshot cadence are otherwise the same
figure_source_correction: Fig. 7a obtains Gaussian 5.643 from job 4868286 via LANDAU_NOISE; the raw-binomial reducer's n=2 matched-width value is 5.872, not 5.643

loo_self_contribution_check.formula: CV=int rho_H^2 - 2*N/(N-1)*(int rho_H*rho_CIC - mean_self/N); mean_self is evaluated from each snapshot's actual bilinear CIC weights

metric_definition.cic_baseline: low-PPC unfiltered CIC snapshot density compared with the paired high-PPC unfiltered CIC snapshot density; both trajectories use the live matched Gaussian sigma=0.25-cell coupling
metric_definition.ensemble_quantity: mean across ten independent seeds of the per-seed time-averaged ISE; called density MISE only after this ensemble average
metric_definition.field_metric: E2 field MSE is grid-node mean[(Ex-Ex_ref)^2+(Ey-Ey_ref)^2] after one density filter and the Poisson solve
metric_definition.fourier_scope: all resolved modes; no Fourier mask. k=0 is formally included in density MSE but vanishes for production pairs by charge normalization; the protected mode is included
metric_definition.noise_reduction: ratio of CIC error power to filtered error power (ratio of ensemble means); it is not an amplitude ratio
metric_definition.particle_force_warning: the field MSE does not apply the return-path filter and does not gather to particles; production particle force uses the full C-W-A-W-C^T chain
metric_definition.reference: paired high-PPC CIC density (16384 PPC for Landau, 1024 PPC for E2), not the filtered candidate and not an analytic density
metric_definition.selection_independence: the MISE width and its reported noise reduction use the same ten seeds, so this is in-sample estimator evaluation rather than a held-out validation; the reference itself does not contain the candidate
metric_definition.stored_per_seed_quantity: time average of the realized grid mean squared charge-density error mean_g[(rho_candidate-rho_reference)^2]

parseval.scope: all resolved modes; no Fourier mask. k=0 is formally included in density MSE but vanishes for production pairs by charge normalization; the protected mode is included
